name: watch_from_words
title: First day · "watch We Work Remotely for back-end roles" becomes a reader, a schedule and rows

steps.say: watch We Work Remotely for back-end roles
steps.reply:
I've set up a watch on We Work Remotely's back-end jobs. It checks the site every morning at 08:00 and tells you which roles are new and which have been taken down. The first check runs tomorrow, 21 October.

There are only six back-end listings on the site right now. I compared the page with the site's own feed and both show the same six, so nothing is missing. All six are full-time, open to applicants anywhere in the world, and saved in a new **Job Search** module:

| Role | Company | Posted |
|---|---|---|
